card.name: Last digit of a percentage
card.fires_on: The final digit of a number just before a percent sign, usually a decimal like 2.5 or 1.3 in adverse-reaction rates. It fires on the digit right before the % closes.

modes.label: Decimal digit before %
modes.description: The last digit of a decimal percentage in trial results or statistics.
modes.example: (2/81, 2.<<5>>%) in one placebo-controlled trial in adults

modes.label: Whole-number digit before %
modes.description: The last digit of a whole percentage in a news or report sentence.
modes.example: another quarter have losses greater than 5<<0>>% -- a devastating cost,"

modes.label: Odd spelled-out or code cases
modes.description: Letters within spaced-out words or a variable in code, also before closing text.
modes.example: B e n z o dia ze p<< i>> n e s : May increase bup

card.writes: It suppresses opening quote marks and promotes closing punctuation, so the next text is a percent sign and closing bracket rather than a quote.
card.plain: It marks the last digit of a percentage, where a percent sign or closing bracket comes next.
